impl.summary: Idol 3D can now save cleaned splat files and use Idol's own crop through the ComfyUI-Idol pack (Nynxz, pinned at 4d3a4f67, Apache-2.0). The pack is pinned in CUSTOM_NODE_REPOS, PACK_CLASSES, install-comfyui.sh NODES, packs.json and requirements.json, and it has a NODE_PACKS licence row. A new graph, image-to-splat-idol-clean, does three things: IdolPreprocessImage replaces TripoSplatPreprocessImage and the core photo crop (cropMode synthetic or real, using Fuobe's cut-out mask); IdolPruneSplat after the decoder feeds both the saved file and the orbit video; and IdolCamera with a 1-frame RenderSplat saves the input-view still, which becomes the card's poster. A PreviewAny reports how many Gaussians were kept. The provider asks GET /object_info/IdolPruneSplat on that worker. The answer is cached for a minute per address. If the server can't be reached, nothing is cached. The cache is cleared when /prompt refuses the clean graph. When the class is there and the pack isn't switched off in Settings → Models & licences, the clean graph runs. Otherwise idol-1's core graph runs, unchanged, and its splat is marked meta.pruned false. 'It's a photo' maps to cropMode real. A new Advanced → 'Trim spikes' switch (open engine only) sends maxScale 0.05. The result card shows 'Cleaned: N Gaussians kept'. Only the owner sees 'Not cleaned: install ComfyUI-Idol…'. Verified: unit tests, the build, and the browser. Not verified here: a /prompt check of the clean graph with the pack installed, which is the owner's step. No splat was run (no GPU, no weights).

Everything else is identical to idol-1's graph (tested).

src/server/providers/comfyui.ts: comfyHasClass(cls, worker, maxAgeMs=60s) uses the same oneAsk and per-address cache as comfyDevice and comfyDbsModels. It returns undefined on someone's computer or when the server can't be reached, and forgetComfyClass() clears the answer. PrepareContext.idolPack is new. prepareWorkflow swaps image-to-splat-idol to -clean when idolPack() returns true and maps the Idol values. In submit, idolPack returns false when Settings switches the ComfyUI-Idol pack off; otherwise it asks /object_info (model-access is imported dynamically to avoid an import cycle). A refused /prompt for the clean graph clears the cached answer. collectOutputs does three new things: the clean graph's PreviewAny count goes on the splat as meta.kept, with pruned true and no separate text output; the core Idol graph's splat gets pruned false; TripoSplat is unchanged.

findings.title: Trim spikes does nothing when the ComfyUI lacks ComfyUI-Idol, and nothing says so
findings.detail: The Advanced -> Trim spikes switch appears on the open engine whatever the server has. idolExtra sends maxScale 0.05. When prepareWorkflow falls back to image-to-splat-idol (no pack, the pack switched off in Settings, or a run on someone's computer, where comfyHasClass returns undefined), idolGraphValues drops maxScale because the core graph doesn't bind it. The run goes ahead without trimming while the summary still reads 'trimming spikes'. The owner only learns about it afterwards from the card's 'Not cleaned' line. Traced in src/lib/av/model3d.ts idolGraphValues (the has(k) guard) and prepareWorkflow L1757-1762; the test 'runs the core graph without the pack...' covers the fallback.
findings.suggestion: Add a short hint under the switch, such as 'Needs the ComfyUI-Idol nodes on your ComfyUI' (owner only), or hide the switch when the server has said it lacks the class.

findings.title: 'Not cleaned: install ComfyUI-Idol' also shows when the pack is installed but was not used
findings.detail: collectOutputs marks every core-graph splat pruned:false. The core graph also runs when the owner switched ComfyUI-Idol off in Settings -> Models & licences, and when the run went through the Fuobe tab relay (computerScope -> comfyHasClass undefined). In both cases the owner is told to install a pack they already have. This is owner-only status text, so no visitor rule is broken.
findings.suggestion: Word it so it fits every case ('Not cleaned: this run used the core nodes; ComfyUI-Idol makes cleaner files'), or record why on meta (no-pack, switched-off, computer).

findings.title: The submit-time wiring of idolPack has no test
findings.detail: tests/idol-clean.test.ts injects idolPack straight into prepareWorkflow and tests comfyHasClass on its own. Nothing tests the submit closure: Settings pack-off returns false before /object_info is asked, and a refused /prompt for the clean graph calls forgetComfyClass. Both are short and read correctly, but a regression there would go unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Add one comfyProvider.submit test with a stand-in ComfyUI. Pack switched off: assert the core graph is posted and no /object_info request is made. /prompt answers 400: assert the next comfyHasClass asks again.

findings.title: With the switch off, the Advanced summary reads 'Advanced · edges'
findings.detail: With Trim spikes off, the disclosure summary is 'Advanced · edges', which doesn't tell the reader anything. 'Advanced' alone, or '· spikes kept', would read better.
findings.suggestion: Show the state only when the switch is on.

fix.finalSummary: Idol 3D on the open engine (your ComfyUI) runs image-to-splat-idol-clean when the server reports IdolPruneSplat and the ComfyUI-Idol pack is not switched off in Settings → Models & licences. That gives Idol's own crop (synthetic, or real for 'It's a photo'), a pruned splat, an input-view poster and a 'Cleaned: N Gaussians kept' line. Otherwise idol-1's core graph runs unchanged, and the owner sees a 'Not cleaned' hint. Advanced → Trim spikes (max_scale 0.05) is open-engine only. The owner is now told it needs the pack. Cloud engine: fal's speridlabs/idol is unchanged, with no pruning and no Trim spikes. Verified: unit tests, including the new submit-path tests (Settings off, cache dropped on a refused /prompt), plus typecheck and lint. Built but not verified: the clean graph with the pack installed (/prompt check), the kept count, the trimming effect and the still. These need a GPU, Idol weights and ComfyUI-Idol at 4d3a4f67, which is the owner's step. No keys are needed. Public sign-up: guests browse the studio read-only and see only plain copy. Accounts still can't run any 3D model (403 own-gpu-tool). The pack hints are owner-only, and no new route or file-reading path was added.
